summary: @ornikar/eslint-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated 727KB payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall="node setup.mjs", which runs unconditionally on npm install. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (identifiers like _0x488df8/_0x52943e alias fs/https/zlib) and probes the host libc (musl vs glibc), downloads a platform-specific Bun release archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, extracts and chmods the Bun binary executable, and invokes it against a sibling math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line opaque bundle prefixed "// @bun @bun-cjs" with string-array rotation/decoder obfuscation (WV8StW push/shift, hc1jfK9 decoder, large opaque n7gIxM constant array). An ESLint configuration package has no functional need to fetch a second language runtime and execute an opaque bundle under it at install time; the shape matches the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern where the fetched official runtime is used to execute the package's own attacker-shipped obfuscated payload rather than the package's normal library code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
